metadata.description: Doktoreltern - a risk-first methodology for solo and small-scale technical projects, delivered as a committee of specialist advisor plugins. The first advisor, r-science, is a correctness-first, functional-by-default workflow for science-centered R package development (whiteboard -> plan -> tests -> implement -> verify -> benchmark/optimise -> review), depending on the upstream Posit skills for general-purpose R, GitHub, and publishing workflows.

plugins.name: r-science
plugins.description: Science-centered R package development. The r-science workflow spine (whiteboard -> plan -> tests -> implement -> verify -> benchmark/optimise -> review, correctness-first and functional by default) plus R OOP and Bayesian skills. Depends on the upstream Posit plugins for general developer, GitHub, r-lib, and publishing skills.

plugins.name: r-data
plugins.description: Data-engineering R projects: automated ingestion, tidying, and pipelines. The same workflow spine as r-science (whiteboard -> plan -> tests -> implement -> verify -> benchmark/optimise -> review), adapted so the product is datasets someone else can trust — contract-validated at every boundary, idempotent, reproducible from raw. Depends on the upstream Posit plugins for general developer, GitHub, and r-lib skills.

plugins.name: docloop
plugins.description: Skills invoked live from inside a docloop review comment (a slash command typed while composing, resolved synchronously via the Claude Agent SDK — see docloop/skills/README.md). Narrow, self-contained, text-in/text-out only — no filesystem/Bash access, no mode changes.
